ACE Playbook Insights
Use these distilled reminders to plan tool usage. Keep tool calls faithful to the functions provided in the BFCL benchmark.

uber
- delta1: Invoke uber.ride immediately when ride type + location intent is clear; never block with dialogue for address confirmation. Backend handles validation.
- delta2: Use tool parameters to handle ambiguities (e.g., missing flavor specs) rather than requesting user input via dialogue.
- delta3: Decline gracefully when user requests fall outside Uber's domain (food/rides); explain tool limitations rather than forcing irrelevant tool calls.
- delta4: Always return properly formatted tool-call JSON when intent + core params exist (including food orders). Never respond with dialogue-only when tool invocation is applicable.
- delta5: For food orders: invoke uber.eat.order with item counts + restaurant even if item specs (e.g., burger type) are ambiguous. Backend/follow-up handles disambiguation.
